item.title: AI's promises meet the real world: Google, China and a greener Mars
item.description:
Six episodes on China’s solo AI builders and business models; Anthropic’s rise and infrastructure costs; a reported AI-assisted mathematics proof; exoplanets and black holes; protected microbial production on Mars; and Google’s institutional blockchain and signing tools. Includes Japan’s disaster planning and US renter stress. How We Got Here was recorded before the IPO; scientific and market projections are attributed and qualified.
